sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, but if any one link is absent, the whole reach dissolves into nothing — quietly, without complaint.

sketches.mechanism: The 'object' keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, enforced by the compiler
sketches.resonance: There will only ever be one of this; the language guarantees what grief already knows.

sketches.mechanism: A pointer to a local variable becomes a dangling pointer after the function returns — the memory existed, but accessing it is undefined behavior
sketches.resonance: You held something real, but the scope that gave it meaning ended, and now reaching for it corrupts everything.
